name: The Trail: Reign of Apocalypse
detailed_description:
A BATTLE AGAINST FATE BEGINS!

Step into the world of The Trail, a handcrafted epic where you forge your own path to success!

As a newly-appointed champion, you've been tasked with assembling a team to prevent a second Great Collapse: a catastrophe that nearly wiped out civilization 1000 years ago. This time, humanity might not be spared. Only the most legendary adventurers stand a chance at saving Telluria!

EXPLORE

  • Journey through diverse locations, from the heart of the World Tree to the depths of Telluria Castle

  • Discover secrets at every turn, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the forgotten stories buried in the wake of destruction

  • Stop by bustling settlements like Haven Harbor and Solus Valley, where NPCs can offer you quests, shops, and new opportunities

  • Meet a cast of memorable characters: a bandit-turned-friend, a self-conscious monarch, and even a guy who swears he can talk to cows...?

COLLECT

Survival won't come easy. At first, you'll be scavenging for scraps, running from monsters, and eating raw food just to stay alive. But as the stakes rise, so will your rewards!

  • Forage and loot to stock up on food, materials, and rare treasure

  • Wield legendary artifacts, like an enchanted coin that transforms you into a fire elemental, or a fabled scroll that wipes out all nearby enemies

  • Master the economy; will you sell everything, or hoard your favorite items?

Every step of your journey brings new opportunities to grow stronger. Will you settle for scraping by, or will you thrive on your journey to save the world?

EQUIP

Build an arsenal that suits your playstyle, with over 300 options for equipment. Whether you'll focus on offensive prowess or your dream defense is up to you.

  • Deck out your party with the strongest gear you can find

  • Harness synergies for combos that will crush your opponents

  • Upgrade your favorite equipment using a wide variety of scrolls and other artifacts

  • Forge powerful combinations and move through legendary upgrade paths, maximizing the potential of every piece of equipment

  • Once you've laid hands on something, it's yours -- no annoying durability systems!

BATTLE

Engage in fast turn-based combat where every decision matters!

  • Use powerful abilities to buff your party members and dish out damage

  • Boost your attacks with a point-based system that rewards you for strategically managing your team

  • Adapt to 10 elements that interact in various ways

  • Slay 15+ bosses with unique twists and rewards

  • No random encounters! When it's time to fight, it won't feel like an ambush

The Trail features a wide variety of enemies, ranging from lowly slimes to literal gods that have descended from The Above. But if you're well-prepared, nearly any setback can be turned into an advantage!

PLAY NOW

A free demo is publicly available, featuring the first few hours of content.

Want to help playtest the full game? Join our growing community on Discord to get a free key, share your journey with other players, and help shape the game's future!

short_description: We were cut off from heaven hundreds of thousands of years ago. Since then, the corrupted soul of an evil god has wrought constant terror and destruction upon us. Will you be able to defy the prophecy and save humanity from an endless cycle of evil?

Minimum:

  • OS *: Microsoft® Windows® 7/8/8.1/10 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
